title: Tracecat 1.5.0-alpha.5
body_markdown:
## Tables


- feat(mcp+tables): Add table folder tools to the MCP server ([#4188](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4188) )


## Agents


- fix(agents): Keep the MCP server up while agent workers drain ([#4181](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4181) )
- feat(agents+ui): Turn on Slack token rotation for new apps ([#4182](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4182) )
- feat(agents): Add Tracecat to Slack in one click from a platform app ([#4183](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4183) )
- feat(agents+ui): Pick Slack channels from a list when routing them ([#4187](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4187) )


## Core actions


- fix(actions): Fit DuckDB to sandbox task and memory limits ([#4191](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4191) )


## User interface


- feat(ui+docs): Show OAuth and GitHub App setup URLs ([#4184](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4184) )


## Infrastructure


- fix(infra): Keep DuckDB 1.4.3 extensions for older registry locks ([#4190](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4190) )


## Documentation


- docs: Add ChatOps page for Slack apps ([#4189](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4189) )


**Full Changelog** :[1.5.0-alpha.4...1.5.0-alpha.5](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/compare/1.5.0-alpha.4...1.5.0-alpha.5)
